BETA Close X CRH plc announced that on April 7, 2026, it repurchased a total of 65,667 of its ordinary shares in the United States through its broker, Wells Fargo Securities, LLC, as part of its ongoing share buyback program. The aggregate volume-weighted average price paid for these shares was $104.9494, with transactions occurring across various trading venues at prices ranging from $103.97 to $105.93. Following these repurchases and subsequent cancellation, CRH plc will have 668,201,112 ordinary shares in issue, excluding treasury shares, and will hold 35,634,977 ordinary shares in treasury, representing 5.063% of the issued ordinary share capital. Disclaimer* 8 th April 2026 CRH plc Transaction in Own Shares CRH plc (“ CRH ”) announces that on 7 th April 2026 it acquired the following number of its ordinary shares (the “ ordinary shares ”) in the United States through CRH’s broker Wells Fargo Securities, LLC. The ordinary shares acquired (by way of redemption) will be cancelled. Following settlement of the above transactions and subsequent share cancellation CRH will have 668,201,112 ordinary shares in issue (excluding treasury shares). CRH will also hold 35,634,977 of its ordinary shares in treasury, which represents 5.063% of the issued ordinary share capital of CRH. Ordinary shares held in treasury do not have any voting rights.
